name: ExpoundCoderz Order Sync with Zoho for WooCommerce
author: Expound Coderz Pvt Ltd

sections.description:
ExpoundCoderz Order Sync with Zoho for WooCommerce helps you connect your WooCommerce store with your Zoho applications and keep business data synchronized.

The plugin supports integration with Zoho Books, Zoho Invoice, and Zoho Inventory, allowing store administrators to import and update important business records directly in WooCommerce.

This plugin helps reduce manual work, avoid duplicate entries, and maintain consistency between WooCommerce and Zoho.

Features

  • Product Sync – Import and update products from Zoho into WooCommerce.
  • Customer Sync – Import customers from Zoho and keep customer records updated.
  • Sales Order Sync – Sync sales orders from Zoho to WooCommerce.
  • Invoice Sync – Import invoices from Zoho into WooCommerce.
  • Multi-App Support – Compatible with Zoho Books, Zoho Invoice, and Zoho Inventory.
  • Smart Record Matching – Updates existing records to help prevent duplicates.

Supported Zoho Applications

  • Zoho Books
  • Zoho Invoice
  • Zoho Inventory

External Services

This plugin connects to Zoho APIs to synchronize data between WooCommerce and Zoho services.

What service is used?

The plugin connects to Zoho APIs for:
* Zoho Books
* Zoho Invoice
* Zoho Inventory

What data is sent and when?

Data may be sent to Zoho when a store administrator authenticates or runs synchronization actions.

Depending on the enabled sync modules, the following data may be exchanged:

  • Product information
  • Customer information
  • Sales order information
  • Invoice information

Authentication requests are also sent to Zoho during account connection and token refresh.

Service provider

This service is provided by Zoho Corporation.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the expoundcoderz-order-sync-zoho-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to the plugin settings page in WordPress admin.
  5. Connect your Zoho account.
  6. Configure synchronization settings for Products, Customers, Sales Orders, or Invoices.
  7. Start syncing your data.
sections.faq:
Which Zoho applications are supported?

This plugin supports Zoho Books, Zoho Invoice, and Zoho Inventory.

Does it support two-way sync?

Currently, this version focuses on importing and updating data from Zoho into WooCommerce.

Will it create duplicate products or customers?

No. The plugin attempts to identify and update existing records to help avoid duplicates.

Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated to use this plugin.
